claude.performance_metric: JVS unit impaired ~$157.7M (FY2020-2022) and divested to Cummins for $325.0M (net ~$321.7M), April 2022
claude.rationale: p4=1: the slice documents a realized product-line/operations incoherence at the Jacobs Vehicle Systems unit within the acquired A&S segment — successive goodwill/intangible impairments (~$147.5M across FY2020-FY2021, plus $10.2M in FY2022) and Altra's explicit decision to "exit the heavy-duty trucks industry," culminating in the JVS divestiture to Cummins in April 2022; this shows the acquired product line could not be sustained within Altra's operations over time. p5=uncertain: the slice contains no primary-verifiable evidence on operations-vs-people/management/culture friction (integration, headcount, and leadership commentary is explicitly marked [UNVERIFIED] and not cited as fact). t1 and t2 are uncertain because the slice discloses only segment financials, impairments, and a subsequent change-of-control merger, with no documented evidence about controlling-intent archetype coherence or reconciliation of business-model value-capture logics.

gemini.rationale: The evidence slice documents the divestiture of the Jacobs Vehicle Systems unit and associated impairments, but does not describe specific product/process integration failures (p4) or process/organizational cultural fractures (p5). The divestiture is attributed to an effort to exit the heavy-duty trucks industry rather than documented operational incoherence.

grok.performance_metric: JVS (part of A&S) divested for $325M after ~$300M impairments; Altra sold 2023
grok.rationale: The slice documents material goodwill/intangible and held-for-sale impairments at the JVS reporting unit within A&S and its April 2022 sale to Cummins to exit heavy-duty trucks, but does not describe product/process interface misalignment or inability to align acquired products with operating processes, so p4_pathway=0. It explicitly marks integration, headcount, and leadership-continuity commentary as unverified and provides no evidence of operations-vs-organization/culture fracture over time, so p5_pathway=0.
